messages:
olivia: Quick sync on PR #5389 — we're updating the 'Rate limits & Quotas' doc to include a tiny migration snippet and a compact SDK example for calculating tiered allowances. Need: 1 short JS snippet, 1 one-line migration callout, and a brief note about alert thresholds. cc @matteo @shira
matteo: I can do the JS. Keep it to 6 lines max. Should we show minutes-to-allowance calc or a direct per-day percent example?
shira: Minutes-to-allowance is more actionable for customers who care about burst behavior. Add a worked example for a 15-minute window and mention we floor enforcement to whole tokens.
matteo: Draft snippet:```js
const tier = {name: 'pro', per_min: 300, per_day: 10000};
function allowance(minutes){ return Math.floor(tier.per_min * minutes); }
console.log(allowance(15)) // 4500 tokens
```
olivia: Perfect. For migration callout: one line: "If you used the legacy meter header, map it to X-Redwood-Usage-Tier and recompute allowances from per_min/per_day fields."
shira: Add an alert sentence: "Alerts use percent_of_daily and are rounded to the nearest integer; enforcement counts integer tokens only."
docs-bot: l10n-check queued for PR #5389.
qa-bot: Note: examples must avoid internal URLs; link to /docs/usage-alerts for the alerting guide.
olivia: Action items: matteo - push snippet to PR; shira - add migration line + alert sentence; i'll merge after docs-bot passes. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
